Hi Priyanka — thanks for the note and great to hear the team liked the demo. Looping in Ben (sales) and Marissa (solutions) so we can cover both contractual and technical packaging.

Short answers up front:
- Voucher pool: yes, we can issue the initial pilot credits as a single redeemable voucher that your program manager can allocate across portfolio startups. That voucher will be valid for 6 months from issuance.
- Convert-to-dedicated discount: we can apply up to a 20% conversion credit (applied against a 3-month Dedicated commit) for credits redeemed into Dedicated within 90 days of voucher activation.

Attached is a starter pricing-grid (pricing-grid.xlsx) showing the standard commit bands and the conversion math. The two options that usually work for accelerators are:
  a) Voucher-only: single pool of free credits (6-month expiry) + no conversion discount.
  b) Voucher + conversion: pool + up to 20% credit applied to a 3-month Dedicated commit (minimum commit required).

Ben / Marissa — can you confirm the minimum Dedicated commit we should quote here and whether we can make the voucher expiry 9 months as a one-time exception?

Next steps: if Foundry confirms which option you prefer I can prepare a short SOW and a conversion addendum.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Hi Priyanka — Ben here. Thanks for the clear ask. A couple of clarifications from the commercial side: 

1) Minimum Dedicated commit for the conversion option is 5 GPU-weeks/month equivalent (we can map this to a $-value in the SOW).
2) The 20% conversion credit is tiered: for pilot credit pools > $25k we can extend up to 25% credit, but that requires manager approval.
3) Voucher expiry flexibility: we can extend to 9 months as a one-time concession for strategic accelerator partners; this requires an approval path.

I've opened a short approval request with Laura for the uplift on the conversion credit and will include a draft addendum in the DocuSign packet if approved. For procurement, here's the SOW template link and a placeholder DocuSign envelope that we can populate: https://app.redwood.com/docs/SOW-template and https://docusign.com/envelopes/REDACTED.
